svg.text: 55 ft road frontage × 80 ft plot depth | Ground + one upper floor | ₹45 lakh budget target
CONCEPT STUDY — north unknown; site placement and setbacks not assigned
≈870 sq ft enclosed + 90 sq ft terrace
Dimensions label planning zones, not clear finished room sizes. Wall thickness reduces usable room area.
Blue marks = windows. Curves = indicative door swings. Stair geometry and openings require detailed design.
Approx. 1,830 sq ft enclosed/covered across both floors; terrace finishing is additional. Porch and parking are outside this drawing.
For architect discussion only — not for construction, approval, structural sizing, or a fixed-price contract.
